# BAD-059 — Pin the thrown-400 boundary on DELETE /session/:id and POST /session/:id/{video,reel,assemble}

## Brief
Risk 4 of the BAD-036 web-api spike: a route called inside handle's try without await lets a rejection escape the catch, so the host answers 500 instead of 400. BAD-049 PR 3's new test 3 pins the boundary for createSession and putBlob only, as the spike specified; deleteSession's and runRender's awaits are guarded by no test, and both routes start with await gatedStore(...), whose readJson throws on an unparseable body.

Evidence: Yukon's scratch copies of the PR 3 tree: dropping await from createSession or putBlob fails webapi.test.js 30/31, but dropping it from 'return await deleteSession(req, res, id)' or the pre-existing 'return await runRender(req, res, id, rest)' passes 31/31. A two-case test in test/webapi.test.js (DELETE /session/<uuid> and POST /session/<uuid>/video with body '{nope' each answer 400 {error}) would close it; section 8 A on base and head already answers 400 for the DELETE case.
